_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. run_command executes an arbitrary shell command via subprocess(shell=True); its child process can touch the filesystem and network without bound, so the legitimate footprint is inherently unrestricted.

run_command.notes: Spawns an arbitrary shell command. The command param is opaque ('Shell command to execute'), so the needed footprint cannot be bounded from the schema. Marked as needing fs read/write and network because an arbitrary command may require any of them.
